evidence.name: RestartGate

function_ir.summary: Session restart and main-menu transition gate polled by GamePostMainLoop. Priority-ordered flag evaluation: byte_7CE25D requests a mini-restart (cleanup pass over vehicle slots, then return 4); byte_7CE25E or byte_7CE260 request a full restart (return 6); dword_7CE264 in state 1 gates a restart on dword_7CE258. Otherwise it walks a restart decision via sub_404B60/sub_485B90, updates a countdown state machine (byte_7CE269 / dword_7CE26C / dword_7CE258), drives the session type/init-guard path (dword_7CE264 -> dword_7C569C = 6 or ConditionalInitGuard), scans the input action map for a menu transition, and finally returns the session-type global dword_7C569C.

operations.description: Guard on mini-restart flag byte_7CE25D; if set, take the cleanup path.
Clear the mini-restart flag byte_7CE25D to 0.
Guard on session type dword_7C56A4 equal to 7 to select the vehicle cleanup loop.
Loop i from 0 while i < dword_5C329C, calling FieldCopy_c330 on each vehicle pointer dword_7C54F0[i] advanced by 16436 bytes.
If ScoringGateCheck() is true and the dword at player vehicle pointer dword_7C54E8 + 13000 equals 1, call SessionStateTransition on dword_7C54E8 + 12 with two zero arguments.
Return 4 for the mini-restart request.
Guard on full-restart flags byte_7CE25E or byte_7CE260; if either is set, clear byte_7CE25E and return 6.
Clear the full-restart flag byte_7CE25E to 0.
Return 6 for the full-restart request.
Guard on dword_7CE264 equal to 1; if dword_7CE258 is also 1, return 6 immediately, otherwise continue at the shared label.
Call sub_404B60 with a pointer to the session directory suffix global dword_5EA43C.
Guard on byte_7CE254; when it is zero, skip the sub_485B90 restart decision path.
Capture the post-increment value of the frame/counter global dword_7CE250 to pass as a tick argument.
Call sub_485B90 with the tick value and byte_7CE25F as arguments and store its result.
Guard on the sub_485B90 result equal to -1 or 3; either returns 6 for a full restart.
Guard on the sub_485B90 result equal to 4; return that result directly.
Countdown state machine: if byte_7CE269 is set, subtract the double constant dbl_8AFE98 from the float stored in dword_7CE26C and write the result back.
When the countdown dword_7CE26C reaches zero or below, clear byte_7CE269, zero dword_7CE26C and set dword_7CE258 to 1.
When dword_7CE258 is not 1, if it equals 2 set it to 1 and continue at the shared label; otherwise proceed directly.
Branch on dword_7CE264: when equal to 1 set dword_7C569C to 6, otherwise call ConditionalInitGuard.
Set the session type global dword_7C569C to 6 to signal a restart/menu transition.

When byte_7CE254 is zero and dword_7CB218 is positive, iterate the input action map word_7CB21C; for each element equal to 1, call ByteFieldExtractorWithShift on dword_5EA43C, and on success set dword_7C569C to 6 and call MainMenuTransition, otherwise set dword_7CE258 to 1.
Call sub_4A0CB0 to complete the per-poll housekeeping.
Return the session type global dword_7C569C as the effective state request.

unresolved: The purpose of the 16436-byte stride and the semantics of FieldCopy_c330's field copy are not established here.
Globals flt_59E440, unk_5EC6D0 and unk_7CE24C are listed in the packet but do not appear in the raw source text; their role is unknown.
